semantic_decisions.warm: cálido naturally describes a friendly, approachable tono, not merely temperature.
semantic_decisions.neutral: neutro is native Spanish and agrees with masculine tono; it is not unsanctioned retained English.
semantic_decisions.bright: animado conveys upbeat/energetic delivery without suggesting visual brightness.
semantic_decisions.calm: sereno is idiomatic for a calm, steady tono and agrees with the masculine setting noun.
semantic_decisions.authoritative: firme conveys confidence and assurance; it avoids the unwanted authoritarian reading.
semantic_decisions.low: baja agrees with feminine expresividad and expresses degree, not volume.
semantic_decisions.medium: media agrees with feminine expresividad and names the middle level unambiguously.
semantic_decisions.high: alta agrees with feminine expresividad and expresses degree, not pitch.
